why: The inserted rule forbidding cuts inside an initial multiword named entity/NP made the scorer prefer leaving the full initial name/NP intact, which moved many early cuts later. That change improved the top-ranked positions (rank_depth gains at depths 1–3 and positive changes for longer bins ≤10/≤99) but removed useful early cut choices for short-latency bins (small negative by_bin at ≤5 and ≤7), producing roughly balanced wins and losses and a negligible overall mean change.
lesson: A later revision should preserve the benefit of keeping initial multiword names for the top one-to-three cut choices while not eliminating the early cut options relied on by short-latency bins (≤5–7).
